title: Spelling Team Champion
goal: I can spell words with ea and oo, and pick the right team.

card.desc: Bristol proves she can spell with the ea team (long e) and the oo team (the moon sound and the book sound), all mixed up. She picks the team by the middle sound, fixes words like red, bock and skool, and writes words from dictation. Page 2 of the packet is a spelling test Tia reads aloud at home.

slides.title: Spelling Team Champion: On Your Own
slides.text: You proved it in class. Now spell like a champion on your own! 🏆

slides.title: Two teams

steps.text: Long e → ea: beach, read, team. (A few say short e: head, bread.)
Moon sound or book sound → oo: moon, school, book, good.
Short e or short o → one letter: bed, hot.

slides.tip: It is read, not red. It is book, not bock!

teacher.objective: Bristol proves she can spell and read words with the ea team (long e, plus the few that say short e) and the oo team (the moon sound and the book sound), mixed together. She picks the right team by the middle sound, tells a team from a single short vowel, fixes misspelled words (red → read, bock → book, skool → school), and writes words from dictation. Week 7 Day 3 (Prove it). In person: she taps and types her own answers.
materials: The Class lesson open on your laptop or tablet (course page, code 9110); she taps and types her own answers
The 10 oo cards from Lesson 17 (ask her to bring them, or make a set), plus 8 new index cards, face down: beach, read, dream, clean, school, food, book, look
Whiteboard and marker, plus paper and pencil
Printed packet (2 pages) to send home. Tell Tia about the spelling test on page 2 (it is on Sunday's line of the task list).

plan.do: Class slide 1. Cards, whiteboard, paper and book on the table. What does ea say? What two sounds can oo say?
Class slide 2. What she read since Monday; an ea word and an oo word from her book.
Class slide 3. Check her Lesson 17 After-Class score first. She types her own answers.
Class slides 4–5. She says the middle sound before you reveal the team.
Class slide 6. ea, oo, e or o. She types it herself.
Class slide 7. She reads each word and taps the box herself.
Class slide 8. You read 8 words with sentences; she writes each one on the whiteboard and checks it with her card.
Class slide 9. The wrong choices mix up the teams. She taps her own pick.
Class slides 11–12. Whiteboard first; then she types it.
Class slide 13. She types the answer.
Class slide 14. Two sentences on paper.
Class slide 15. On her own. She types each answer.
Class slide 16. Show the task list: tonight the After-Class Lesson and 10 minutes of reading; Wednesday the reading lesson; the Practice and Packet on the weekend. Lesson 19 is Thursday, in person.

watch: Mixing the teams (meen or mean for moon, toom for team). Ask: "Long e, or the moon sound?"
One letter where a team is needed (bock, mon, bech, clen). Ask: "Is it a short sound, like bed or hot? If not, use a team."
red for read and bock for book: her own mistakes. Praise every time she gets them right.
skool or scool for school. It is a word to remember: s-c-h-o-o-l.
Reading head, bread or feather with long e. Remind her: try long e first; if it does not make sense, try short e.

packet_key.answer: The food is on the table.
Any sentence that uses two of the spelling words, spelled right, with a capital letter and a period.

teacher.notes: Tonight is light on purpose: the After-Class Lesson (it ends with Show What You Know, 3 sets that rotate on retakes) and 10 minutes of reading; the Vowel Team Sentences reading lesson is on Wednesday. The Practice and the Packet are on the weekend (after Lesson 19), so the Lesson 19 task list does not need to repeat them. Page 2 of this packet is a spelling test Tia reads aloud (the word list is at the bottom of page 2, to fold back); it is on Sunday's line of the task list. Ask Tia to send a photo of page 2, or have Bristol show it at her next lesson. If she scores under 85 on Show What You Know, start Lesson 19 (Thursday, in person) with 5 minutes of the word cards, then she retakes it (new set).

tasks: Tuesday night: do the After-Class Lesson. Finish with Show What You Know.
Tuesday night: read your book for 10 minutes. Look for words with ea and oo.
Wednesday: do the reading lesson Reading Foundations: Vowel Team Sentences. Read sentences with vowel teams smoothly. Aim for 90. If it is locked, type 1111.

Saturday: do the Lesson 18 Practice. Try to get 85 or more. Then do the reading lesson Reading Foundations: Vowel Team Mix & Read. Read words with every vowel team you know. Aim for 90. If it is locked, type 1111.
Sunday: do the Lesson 18 Packet. On page 2, Mom reads the spelling test to you. Show it to Jonathan at your next lesson.
Lesson 19 is Thursday, in person. Bring your book.
